 if p.returncode:raise RuntimeError(p.stdout.decode('utf-8','replace')+'\n'+p.stderr.decode('utf-8','replace'))

record={'machine_id':machine_id(),'started_at_utc':utc_now(),'status':'before_publication_lock','paths_and_sha256':{p:file_sha256(ROOT/p) for p in paths}};write_json(receipt,record)
lock=ROOT/'runtime/production-publish.lock';fd=os.open(lock,os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|os.O_WRONLY)
with os.fdopen(fd,'w',encoding='utf-8') as f:json.dump({'machine_id':machine_id(),'process_id':os.getpid(),'batch':'fresh-mouth-prompt-20261026','acquired_at_utc':utc_now()},f)
try:
 assert git('rev-parse','HEAD').decode().strip()==base and not git('diff','--cached','--name-only').strip()

 git('diff','--check','--',*paths);git('add','--',*paths);assert set(git('diff','--cached','--name-only').decode().splitlines())==set(paths)
 git('commit','-m','Clarify mascot mouth anatomy for new source prompts');commit=git('rev-parse','HEAD').decode().strip();record.update(status='committed_push_pending',commit=commit);write_json(receipt,record)

 if observed!=commit:git('fetch','origin','master');git('merge-base','--is-ancestor',commit,observed)
 record.update(status='committed_and_pushed',remote_master_observed=observed,completed_at_utc=utc_now())
